objective: Collect a real audience question for later research
copy:
Which question do customers ask you every week?
A. What is included?
B. How much?
C. Do you cover my area?
D. Something else — reply
interaction: Poll: A/B/C/D where the platform supports it; otherwise question sticker or text replies
visual: Beige field, four outlined green answer rows; no invented poll result
cta: Vote or reply; no private customer details.

objective: Extend the first-screen test without copying the carousel
copy:
Quick test: ask someone new to your page, “What do you think I sell?”
If their answer surprises you, write down the exact words before editing.
interaction: Optional question sticker: What did they say? (no personal details)
visual: One open notebook line and small green question mark
cta: Try this with one willing reader.

objective: Invite a scoped conversation without a price claim
copy:
If your customers keep asking the same buying question, your message may need a clearer route.
Want to discuss the gap? Message CLARITY. We’ll confirm what help is available.
interaction: DM keyword only if account owner confirms inbox monitoring
visual: Green field, beige type; one understated message icon
cta: Message CLARITY after monitoring and service availability are confirmed.
